desc: Read S from stdin and strip whitespace/newline.
Build T = reverse(S) + '#' + S using a separator that cannot appear in S.
Compute the KMP prefix function for T in linear time.
Let k = pi[-1]; this is the longest suffix of S that equals a prefix of reverse(S), i.e. the longest palindromic suffix length.
Output S + reverse(S[:n-k]), where n = len(S).
Verify correctness on edge cases: single character, already palindrome, and no palindromic suffix longer than 1.
Verify solution passes public sample tests.
